# Upstream reference source — not study-validated SQL

All SQL in this directory is reference material from pinned MIT-LCP commits. It has not been validated against the actual databases for this study. Some files include table DDL; do not execute them as production extraction commands. Use the six SELECT-only queries in sql/. The original source bodies and MIT notices are retained for attribution and review. The repository-wide status is 未经数据库验证 / NOT VALIDATED AGAINST ACTUAL SOURCE DATABASES.
